text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Monday arrived in Argentina for a three-day visit.
- Argentinian daily paper "Nacion" published on Monday an iterview of President Ben Ali.
- Tunisia and India to boost scientific research cooperation.
- Tunisia participated at the Mediterranean textile exhibition held in Brussels on March 20-22.

- Kuwaiti head of state Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah on Sunday received visiting Tunisian Trade Minister Mondher Zenaidi and stressed the importance of boosting cooperation between the two countries.
- Tunisia and Egypt held talks in Cairo on ways to set up a free trade zone between the two countries.
